router_body:
name: plan
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: full job set selected
        if: ${{ github.event_name != 'pull_request' || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'full-matrix') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'ci') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'release-matrix') }}
        run: echo 'SELECTED gate'
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        if: ${{ github.event_name != 'pull_request' || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'full-matrix') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'ci') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'release-matrix') }}
      - name: local gate wiring proof
        if: ${{ github.event_name != 'pull_request' || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'full-matrix') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'ci') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'release-matrix') }}
        run: python3 -I ci/local-gate-test.py
      - name: local evidence gate
        if: ${{ !(github.event_name != 'pull_request' || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'full-matrix') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'ci') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'release-matrix')) }}
        run: echo 'Local gauntlet evidence is the gate; request ci or full-matrix for CI.'

ci.yml.gate:
name: ${{ matrix.name }} (fmt, build, units, CLI e2e)
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - {name: linux x86-64, os: ubuntu-latest, arch: x86_64}
          - {name: macOS arm64, os: macos-latest, arch: arm64}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: lane-local temporary files
        shell: bash
        run: |
          test "$(uname -m)" = '${{ matrix.arch }}'
          mkdir -p "$HOME/lanes/pm01/tmp"
          echo "TMPDIR=$HOME/lanes/pm01/tmp" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: digest-pinned wolf and lupin
        run: tools/fetch-toolchain
      - name: fmt
        run: tools/check-fmt
      - name: build
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: tools/build
      - name: units, S3-solver-exhaustive and S1-held-package-refused
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: tools/check-test
      - name: CLI fixture e2e, both executable names
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: tools/check-e2e
